selection_note: The ID range is not a wildcard: model string and exact source row must match. Status and DC mode dependencies remain source-specific.

functional_classes.rule: Grid-versus-phase identity and B/C validity depend on output mode; do not instantiate three phases solely because words exist.
Documented active/reactive/peak power tuple. Preserve source sign uncertainty and distinction between instantaneous, peak and fast unfiltered observations.
Output wiring selects grid/UW/UO/WO meanings and invalid channels. Off-grid suppresses selected phase voltages. The 42001 prose is not an automatic topology detector.
Alarm counts and event sequences are distinct from bitmaps. Source increment/skip-zero behavior is retained where stated; cross-register atomicity and unspecified wrap boundaries remain unknown.
Additional alarm-group words and GroupID values do not supply bit dictionaries. Do not reuse the first-three-word mapping.
The first three alarm words have 41 reviewed mappings and module footnotes in this source. Clear bits do not establish module absence; unlisted bits remain unknown.
Read the entire declared MLD field. Internal layout is unavailable unless explicitly listed; no borrowed subregister or cross-field atomicity contract.
Literal tuple retained, disputed semantic interpretation quarantined; no silent repair of unit, type or field meaning.
Documented quantities bound possible topology or inventory. They do not prove connection, production or enablement.

Model/count gates apply. The first two channel pairs depend on mask14 bit9 and referenced 30205 for PV-versus-MPPT naming; unresolved binding requires neutral DC labels. Other pairs do not inherit that remapping automatically.
Documented DC power quantity. Signed wire type alone does not establish a physical import/export convention.

Internal component runtime, temperatures, bus/DCI/residual-current fields are inspection/R&D observations, often five-minute records. No component-presence or safety conclusion follows from readability.
Meaning changes between generation and absorption. Mode evidence is required; readable efficiency does not establish storage operation.

Period-specific or cumulative energy in the documented unit. Reset, rollover, time boundaries and identity continuity are separate. A total-DC row named power but carrying kWh is presented as a unit-based energy interpretation, with its naming ambiguity retained.
Time-bearing values require the exact source type, timezone and sentinel rule. No general UTC conversion or epoch signedness is invented.
Raw highest-priority fault identifier. The external fault-description sheet is needed for labels/priority policy; numeric ordering is not priority.
Support, presence, grid-code and parameter-mask fields remain separate. Missing bit identities prevent feature discovery; nonzero is not a universal support predicate.
30206 distinguishes unconfigured/configured with 0/1 wording, but no functional-unit bit dictionary is established. Preserve raw bits and do not identify an attached device from this alone.
Model, serial, part and component-version fields preserve bounded raw identity; encoding/padding must be qualified. A component string is not presence evidence.
Raw product, software, model and package identifiers. Blank gains are not physical scales.
Meter status/type/check fields are E16 with no recovered value dictionary. Do not import M10 0/1 semantics.

Exact attached meter presence, topology and validity are needed. MC explicitly defines export-positive/import-negative for active power; MA-V200 has no equivalent sign statement in these rows and does not inherit it.
MPPT energy/power fields need actual documented topology. A management-UI note or extra address does not prove that tracker exists.
Complete package-descriptor words preserve file/device identifiers. Missing type dictionaries block semantic expansion, not raw transport.
PID/single-stage applicability is required where named. A class code such as 1502 at32182 is not a measured voltage; source class labels and their ambiguities remain separate.
RO predicted MPPT power is distinct from measured production, even though it appears among controls.
Opaque U32 protocol identity; source separates main/revision portions. Preserve raw value and do not infer a feature bitmap.
Nameplate limits differ from currently adjustable limits; 30075/30077 mirror 42027/42025 and reactive limits can change with grid-code/derating context.
Ordinary source-defined frequency, temperature, factor or insulation scalar. Physical safety thresholds and undocumented sentinels are not inferred.
Raw serial fingerprint value; the exact serial-byte/CRC computation is not defined by this row, so no independent calculation is assumed.
Complete status or enum field is readable, but missing source dictionaries prevent semantic labels. Do not transplant another branch enum.
MA38914 event codes0–3 and38915 health-check codes0–4 are explicitly defined. These are observational results, not instructions to start a check.
Unit/pack identity or firmware is associated with that exact attachment slot. A readable placeholder does not establish an installed pack.
MA37006 has its own mode enumeration0–12.
Apply exact ESU/pack/parallel-system identity and verified presence. Units/scales are row-specific; no offset cloning or unsupported sign convention is assumed.
MA unit1/unit2/aggregate states0–4 are explicitly offline/standby/running/fault/sleep. MC battery E16 has no dictionary here and remains raw. Pack/SOH states do not inherit unit-state codes.
Pack working-state, SOH/calibration or other unmapped storage code is retained raw. A numeric type or gain does not supply an enum or boolean meaning.

Positive means charging; negative means discharging in this exact unit row.
